# Shared setup for the five decks + cheat sheet (labs carry their own inline copy so each lab stays a standalone script).
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(tidyverse); library(survival); library(broom); library(gtsummary); library(ggsurvfit) })
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 16))
tb_path <- c("data/tb_cohort.csv", "../data/tb_cohort.csv", "../../data/tb_cohort.csv")
tb_path <- tb_path[file.exists(tb_path)][1]
tb <- read_csv(tb_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")), hiv = factor(hiv, levels = c("Negative", "Positive")),
         diabetes = factor(diabetes, levels = c("No", "Yes")), smoker = factor(smoker, levels = c("No", "Yes")),
         mdr_tb = factor(mdr_tb, levels = c("No", "Yes")), smear = factor(smear, levels = c("Negative", "Positive")),
         treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("Self-administered", "DOT")))
col_blue <- "#3498db"; col_red <- "#e74c3c"; col_navy <- "#2c3e50"; col_green <- "#27ae60"

chunks.code:
tb |> select(id, age, hiv, mdr_tb, treatment, time_months, status) |> head(6)
table(tb$status)

tb |> slice(1:15) |> mutate(row = row_number(), outcome = ifelse(status == 1, "Died", "Censored")) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = reorder(id, -row))) + geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = time_months, yend = reorder(id, -row)), colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(aes(x = time_months, colour = outcome, shape = outcome), size = 3) + scale_colour_manual(values = c(Died = col_red, Censored = col_blue)) +
  labs(x = "Months of follow-up", y = NULL, colour = NULL, shape = NULL)

py <- sum(tb$time_months) / 12
c(deaths = sum(tb$status), person_years = round(py, 1), rate_per_100_py = round(sum(tb$status) / py * 100, 1))

rkm <- survfit(Surv(time_months, 1 - status) ~ 1, data = tb)
c(median_raw_time = median(tb$time_months), median_followup_reverse_KM = unname(summary(rkm)$table["median"]))
